name: Block Blast 3D
short: A fast, offline-ready puzzle game with 3D visuals and multiple theme sounds. Install it on your phone or computer and play anywhere, even without internet.
description:
Block Blast 3D is a fast and smooth puzzle game with 3D visuals and multiple built-in theme sounds. It is a Progressive Web App: after the first load it works offline thanks to a service worker, and it can be installed on Android, iPhone and desktop like a native app.

The game is family friendly. It has no ads of any kind, no inappropriate content and no gambling or betting promotions.

Made by StepTuDeen.
